CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CustomerAccount_BOB
AS
BEGIN


--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount AS 
(
SELECT
	BBC.ID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BBC.NM AS CustomerAccountName
	,BBTC.CREATED_DT AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,BBC.UPDATE_DT  AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
	,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
	,NULL AS CustomerId
	,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
	,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS LedgerId
	,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
	,NULL AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountTypeId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
	,NULL AS Last6AccountNumber
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountShortName
	,NULL AS BranchId
	,'BOB' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BBC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountNote
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BBC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BBTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLCORPORATION_DELTA BBTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.BOB_TBLCORPORATION BBC ON BBTD.ID = BBC.ID AND BBTD.VERSION = BBC.VERSION AND BBC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT BBTC ON BBC.REF_NO = BBTC.REF_NO AND BBC.ISLATEST = 1
WHERE BBC.STATUS IN (9, 12, 14, 15)

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'BOB'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
	,CustomerAccountName = SRC.CustomerAccountName
	,CustomerAccountOpenedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,CustomerAccountClosedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountClosedDate
	,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber = NULL
	,CustomerId = NULL
	,ResponsibilityCenterId = NULL
	,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId = NULL
	,LedgerId = NULL
	,LedgerAccountNumber = NULL
	,IsoCurrencyCode = NULL
	,CustomerAccountTypeId = NULL
	,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber = NULL
	,Last6AccountNumber = NULL
	,CustomerAccountShortName = NULL
	,BranchId = NULL
	,SourceSystemCode = 'BOB'
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,CustomerAccountNote = NULL
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccount
(
	CustomerAccountId
	,CustomerAccountName
	,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,CustomerAccountClosedDate
	,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
	,CustomerId
	,ResponsibilityCenterId
	,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
	,LedgerId
	,LedgerAccountNumber
	,IsoCurrencyCode
	,CustomerAccountTypeId
	,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
	,Last6AccountNumber
	,CustomerAccountShortName
	,BranchId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,CustomerAccountNote
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	CustomerAccountId
	,CustomerAccountName
	,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,CustomerAccountClosedDate
	,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
	,NULL AS CustomerId
	,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
	,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS LedgerId
	,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
	,NULL AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountTypeId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
	,NULL AS Last6AccountNumber
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountShortName
	,NULL AS BranchId
	,'BOB' AS SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId

	,NULL AS CustomerAccountNote
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;


END
